title: Celestial Eight Trigrams Judgment
body:
Syntax: perform celestial eight trigrams judgment [target]

Minimum level 100, Byakugan mastery 90% and inherited Potential 95 or higher. This is a clan-exclusive Gentle Fist technique, dealing damage to the opponent and targeting chakra/stamina pathways. Successful hits may seal tenketsu briefly, stopping jutsu use. See 'help hyuga' for full bloodline rules. A technique only becomes available when level, mastery, and the character's permanent bloodline potential all qualify.
